newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-TEAMS FOR ITALY V POLAND WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TEAMS FOR ITALY V POLAND WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.

text.p: Teams for the World Cup group two qualifier between Italy and Poland on Wednesday:

Italy: 1-Angelo Peruzzi, 2-Ciro Ferrara, 7-Angelo Di Livio, 6-Alessandro Costacurta, 5-Fabio Cannavaro, 3-Paolo Maldini, 8-Roberto Di Matteo, 10-Demetrio Albertini, 4-Dino Baggio, 11-Gianfranco Zola, 9-Fabrizio Ravanelli.

Poland: 1-Andrzej Wozniak, 2-Pawel Skrzypek, 3-Jacek Zielinski, 4-Pawel Wojtala, 5-Tomasz Waldoch, 6-Marek Citko, 7-Radoslaw Kaluzny, 8-Henryk Baluszynski, 9-Cezary Kucharski, 10-Piotr Nowak, 11-Adam Ledwon.
